command_line:
set -eu
python - <<'PY'
import inspect
import pydeseq2
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
with open('preflight.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as out:
    out.write('pydeseq2_version=' + str(getattr(pydeseq2, '__version__', 'unknown')) + '\n')
    out.write('DeseqDataSet_signature=' + str(inspect.signature(DeseqDataSet)) + '\n')
    out.write('DeseqStats_signature=' + str(inspect.signature(DeseqStats)) + '\n')
    out.write('lfc_shrink_signature=' + str(inspect.signature(DeseqStats.lfc_shrink)) + '\n')
PY
